title: AddRuleSpec
description: INPUT of `rulekit add <model.json> <rule-spec.json>` — the rule envelope to persist. The condition is validated against the real kernel before writing, and the persisted model is re-validated (so every declared message locale must be covered).

field.description: the error field's ABSOLUTE path, e.g. /Order/Quantity; its parent group is the rule's iteration scope

condition.description: the condition in A12 DSL — TRUE on a violation (the rule fires when it holds)

messages.description: ≥1 localized message; cover every locale the model declares

locale.description: a full locale code, e.g. en_US (bare 'en' is rejected by the kernel)
